title: Highmoor Rising Revisited
author: Lior Villalobos
blurb: Ansel Blackwood, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
